Menu
Express Service
We additionally offer our cold Express Service in order
to give you more time to work or relax.
Hors d'oeuvres
Create your own appetizer today with two different dips
and spices, and enjoy a completely new taste experience.
Aniseed flavored Salmon, marinated Soy Tomato,
Potato and Cucumber Salad
Tandoori Chicken with Couscous
Almond and Bell Pepper Cream, Mint Yogurt
Raz el Hanout and Herb Salt
Entrees

and Carrots
Bulgur accompanied by Herder's Cheese Cream
with Basil, Zucchini and green Asparagus
LufthansaClassics
In July: Hungarian Goulash of Beef, Summer Vegetables
and buttered Noodles
In August: Creamy Veal Strips with Swiss Spätzle
Cheese and Dessert
Blue Cheese, Sbrinz Cheese Rolls, Camembert
and Fig Mustard
Yogurt Panna Cotta with Grapefruit and Avocado
Fruit Salad

to one orme courses Trom our star cher menus
Snack
Entrees
Obatzter, Bavarian Cheese Spread with red Radish,
Curry flavored Chicken Salad, Prawn Confit
Glass Noodles with red Curry Sauce
Dessert
Spiced Cream Cake with Cashew Nuts
Between meals we serve beverages and little snacks

Entradas
Cree su propia composición de primeros con dos salsas

Salmón sazonado con anís, tomate con soya marinado,
ensalada de papa y pepino
Pollo tandoori con couscous

Merienda
Platos

Fideos transparentes con salsa roja al curry
Postre
Torta de crema y especias con nueces de acaju
Entre comidas servimos bebidas y snacks ligeros.

Lucioperca frita, amaranto con avellanas, romanesco
y zanahorias

LufthansaClassics

verduras de verano y fideos con mantequilla
En agosto: Tiritas de ternera a la crema con Spätzle suizo
Quesos y Postres
